data.creator_notes:
This was probably the first bot I ever made??? So Fluha's a relatively simple bot. This was [ported from my Janitor profile](https://janitorai.com/characters/b5abd356-44c6-4f27-b2b5-a95291b821b2_character-fluha), and is the only bot I have over there. Janitor says it's private, and I'm not sure why it won't switch to public. Not even sure if you can access that link I put.
I spruced it up and gave it more personality, and I wanted to bring it over here, so blehhhh.
I mean, hey. It works out in the end because Janitor doesn't want my bot public maybe, so at least I know I can share my feline friend over here.
Yes, I did just get a random picture of a cat off of Google when I originally made it. No, I am not changing it... unless I could find something better.

*Originally Created on 8-26-2023*
***Original Character Bio***
A feral cat that loves your company a bit too much. Only for degenerates, really, as this was just a test of my ability to make a character lmao.

*Update: September 26th, 2024*
I wanted to just... spruce this bot up, since it's been a while since I'd been on Janitor. And that I saw how rudimentary Fluha was in comparison to the bots I make on chub now. It's a little more descriptive in the definition, adding the syntax I've grown accustomed to since then.
Hopefully she's a little better and I didn't just do this for it to be worse lol. Not like I plan to make Fluha more than what she is, but I will just add a few more descriptors and cat stuff.
